Name: More Furniture At Robin's - Increased Random Daily Stock at Carpenter Shop
Author: cosmicRetribution
Description:
The way furniture items are drawn for Robin's daily stock is ... somewhat odd. Essentially, according to the wiki, a handful of items are drawn from specific item pools that differ based on the day of the week.
However, when searching for new furnitures to decorate my house with, I always felt that the number of options available on a day to day basis were quite small, didn't make for a lot of variety, and tended to become repetitive.

So, if you have ever wished that Robin carried more furniture options for sale in her daily stock, this mod is for you. :)


[size=4][i]More Furniture At Robin's, [/i]by default, will add an additional 20 randomly selected items to Robin's shop as rotating daily stock. [/size]

[list] [*][b]The number of items to be added as rotating daily stock can be configured[/b] via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, if you would like more or less items to be made available.

[*]This mod doesn't touch the rotating stock drawn from daily item pools in vanilla Stardew, so the furnitures that she would normally sell on any given day of the week, are still there. For your convenience, you will find the new entries added by this mod after the calendar item in her stock list. [size=2](Items drawn by vanilla methods will be [i]above[/i] the calendar in the list; items drawn by this mod will be [i]below[/i] the calendar, just for organizational purposes)[/size]

[*]I haven't touched the prices at all, so each item will sell for whatever the game thinks it should sell for.

[*]The items selected are completely random, with the parameters that they "must be valid for random selection" (ie. it shouldn't randomly draw spouse portraits or heart event furniture, etc). It seems that sometimes furnitures that are also sold at festivals may be drawn, but theoretically there shouldn't be anything too crazy in there! 
[/list]
_____

[size=4]Installation[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]This mod is for Stardew Valley 1.6[/size]
[*][size=2]Please make sure that you have the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/size]
[*][size=2]If you would like to configure the amount of furnitures added, please make sure that you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ installed[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip this file into your game's Mods folder, as per usual[/size]
[*][size=2]For Uninstallation: If you would like to revert to the default selection of furnitures in Robin's shop, simply delete "[CP] MoreFurnitureAtRobin's" from your mods folder. [/size]

[/list][size=2]If you like this mod, you may also like my [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21997]More Wallpaper and Flooring At Pierre's[/url] [/i]mod :)
[/size]
Happy Decorating!
